connector.name: BuyWhere MCP Server (buywhere-mcp)
connector.registryDescription: Agent-native product catalog for AI shopping agents. 296M+ products, 28 countries.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.buywhere.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the buywhere account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Get a free key at https://api.buywhere.ai/v1/auth/register (1,000 calls/month, no credit card).
